topic: Using an Entrepreneurial Mindset to Construct a Winning Chem-E-Car
title: Using an Entrepreneurial Mindset to Construct a Winning Chem-E-Car
session_title: Entrepreneurial Mindset and Chemical Engineering (Invited talks)
abstract: Each year, AIChE conducts the Chem-E-Car Competition that tasks teams of college students with designing and building a shoebox-sized car powered by a chemical energy source that will safely travel a specific given distance and then stop utilizing a chemical reaction. In 2021, the Univ. of Toledo (UToledo) Chem-E-Car Team exhibited the entrepreneurial mindset through the application of curiosity, connections, and creating value in the construction of the zinc-nickel battery for their Chem-E-Car. They earned first place in the Annual Student Conference Chem-E-Car Competition (earning the H. Scott Fogler trophy) by stopping just 10 cm from the target distance of 21.05 m.
presenting_author: Kevin Fruth | Cenovus Energy, Toledo, OH
authors: Kevin Fruth | Cenovus Energy, Toledo, OH

topic: Entrepreneurially Minded Learning in the Chemical Engineering Unit Operations Laboratory
title: Entrepreneurially Minded Learning in the Chemical Engineering Unit Operations Laboratory
session_title: Entrepreneurial Mindset and Chemical Engineering (Invited talks)
abstract: Over the past few years, chemical engineering students in the unit operations laboratory have been encouraged to adopt an entrepreneurial mindset (EM) to solve non-traditional unit operations experiments. Specifically, the KEEN framework of the 3 C's, curiosity, connections, and creating value, has been implemented to work on final open-ended projects with sponsors outside the University. It has been demonstrated that students' self-directed learning correlates with EM when working in the laboratory. This talk briefly discusses final project assignments, deliverables, assessment methods, stakeholders, benefits, opportunities, and limitations.
presenting_author: Erick Vasquez | University of Dayton, OH
authors: Erick Vasquez | University of Dayton, OH
